newsitem.title: USA: Wesley-Jessen cuts IPO price range to $15-$16.
newsitem.headline: Wesley-Jessen cuts IPO price range to $15-$16.

text.p: Wesley-Jessen VisionCare Inc, the soft contact lens maker, cut the price for shares in its proposed initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing.
The company had originally filed for an offering of 2.4 million shares between $19 and $21 a share but cut the estimated price to between $15 and $16 a share.

The lower pricing comes in the wake of an amended filing, dated January 30, in which the company disclosed it expects to post a net loss of $1.1 million before an extraordinary item on sales of $156.7 million. Including the item, the net loss for 1996 is $2.7 million.
Shares are expected to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "WJCO". The IPO is tentatively due to price later this week, according to lead underwriter Merrill Lynch & Co.
